name: read_tool_result
description:
Read a previously stored full tool result by `tool_result_id`.

Use this ONLY when the summary is insufficient and you need exact details from a prior tool call
(for example: reusing a Playwright snapshot `ref`, seeing full JSON payloads, or verifying exact values).

This tool reads artifacts from `uploads/temp/tool_results/`.

inputs.name: field
inputs.description: Optional dotted path into the stored JSON (e.g., tool_result.data.call_response.result).

inputs.name: max_chars
inputs.description: Maximum characters to return. Use 0 for no truncation (can be very large).

inputs.name: contains
inputs.description: Optional substring filter. If provided, only lines containing this substring will be returned (applied after selecting `field` and before `max_chars` truncation). Useful for huge snapshots, e.g. contains='ref=' or contains='link '.

arguments_prompt:
Provide arguments to load a stored tool result artifact.

Rules:
- Prefer providing `field` to extract only what you need.
- Keep `max_chars` reasonably small unless you have a strong reason.

Arguments schema:
{{ user_context }}
